backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, and authorization with in-memory maps and ID counters.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping homepage redesign features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for all pages and wraps the app with theme and toast providers.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading state and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper component that shows a sign‑in prompt when the user is unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/landing/Toolshed: Reusable themed homepage section with decorative shed‑style visuals and optional variants.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders a simple footer with a copyright notice and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the main site header with navigation, auth controls, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with a header, footer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Provides a filter bar for browsing tools, including search, category, sorting, price, and availability.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Handles camera access, photo capture, error states, and returns captured images as data URLs.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a responsive grid of tool listings with photos, category, description, and availability.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Shows owner-only actions for editing a listing and toggling its availability.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Lets users add, remove, or capture photos for listings via URLs or the device camera.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active rental conversation with tool info, user details, rental dates, and status, and embeds the RentalChatPanel. Shows a placeholder when no conversation is selected.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations with tool titles, user roles, and status badges, allowing selection of a conversation. Highlights the currently selected rental.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Provides a user profile dropdown with avatar, profile details, navigation to profile, and logout functionality. Integrates with Internet Identity and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Shows a mandatory setup dialog for authenticated users without a profile, allowing them to enter name, contact info, and location. Saves updates via createOrUpdateProfile.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Displays messages for a rental, supports sending new messages, auto-scroll, and timestamp formatting. Handles loading, error, and empty states with optional messaging view variant.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form for submitting a rental request with date validation and availability checks, sending the request and navigating on success. Shows loading and error toasts.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Provides UI buttons and confirmation dialogs for owners or renters to update a rental's status using a mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity authentication, storing identity state, login flow, and exposing an authentication context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, tool listings, searches, rentals, and mutations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom color variables and theming for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, providing QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page for searching and displaying tool listings with filters and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, visuals, and navigation actions based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single tool listing, including photos, availability, owner actions, and rental request form.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Provides a create/edit form for tool listings with fields for details, photos, pricing, and availability.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Shows user conversations tied to rentals, with a list of chats and an active conversation panel.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Lists the user's rental requests and bookings with status badges and links to view details or tools.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the user's tool listings and highlights pending or active rental requests with management options.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Allows users to view and edit their profile information, including name, contact info, location, and picture.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific rental, including status, tool data, cost, and actions for owners or renters.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Shows incoming rental requests for a user's tools with status indicators, tool info, and management actions.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Converts a File object into a data URL string using FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Formats a join timestamp into human‑readable elapsed time and a formatted join date.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, persist, and clear URL parameters using both query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, image needs, and homepage redesign goals.
